threat_vectors.description: Inconsistent product prices and payment method discrepancies may indicate compliance and security risks, potentially impacting revenue and customer trust.

threat_vectors.description: Unaccounted inventory and inconsistent restocking dates pose operational risks, potentially impacting revenue and customer satisfaction.

immediate_actions: Conduct a thorough review of sales records and supplier information to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Implement price consistency checks across all product categories to prevent discrepancies.
Review and adjust restocking dates to ensure timely replenishment of inventory.
monitoring_recommendations: Continuously monitor sales records and inventory levels to detect potential discrepancies.
Implement regular price audits to prevent inconsistencies and ensure compliance.
Monitor payment methods and transactions to detect potential security risks.
